description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SerializationException' within the 'Laminas\Diactoros\Exception' namespace. It extends the built-in 'UnexpectedValueException' and provides static methods to generate specific exception instances related to serialization errors in HTTP request/response processing.

classes.name: SerializationException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating errors during serialization/deserialization processes, particularly in HTTP message handling.

methods.name: forInvalidRequestLine
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SerializationException indicating an invalid request line was detected.

methods.name: forInvalidStatusLine
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SerializationException indicating no status line was detected.
